fields.total_premium: Total premium payable, including taxes and fees (printed as Total Payable)
fields.minimum_earned_premium: Minimum earned premium, as an amount or percent
fields.retroactive_date: Retroactive date for claims-made coverage, or Full Prior Acts
fields.tech_eo_limit: Technology errors and omissions liability limit, each claim
fields.tech_eo_retention: Technology errors and omissions liability retention, each claim
fields.cyber_liability_limit: Network security and privacy liability limit, each claim
fields.cyber_liability_retention: Network security and privacy liability retention, each claim
fields.cyber_crime_limit: Cyber crime (funds transfer fraud, social engineering) sublimit

proposals.description: Three carriers quoting one Cyber and Technology E&O program; two single-column quotes and one whose insuring agreement schedule is a two-column table.
Two carriers, no-AI-prose mode. One quote states no cyber crime coverage and no AM Best rating (null cells that must show no value); the other is a two-column table.
Two carriers; one quote's declarations state a cyber crime sublimit that a later endorsement replaces (truth is the amended figure, the declared one is a decoy).
